description: A wicker basket with a baguette and a burger sits on a red tablecloth, and a gray plate beside it holds a yellow banana-shaped piece, a yellow mango-like piece, a few dark grapes, and a red strawberry-like piece. The right hand reaches in toward the plate, pinches the red strawberry-like piece, lifts it up and slightly left toward the basket, places it down among the other items in the basket, and then withdraws back to the right, leaving the strawberry as the right-hand object only while it’s being carried.
